attempt_sequence: t=0..max_attempts-1: N=N0*2**t, P=P0*2**t; check exponent, result bit and allocation/work bounds BEFORE shift or power; first disallowed attempt terminates UNPROVED/STOP
determinism: same input/spec/source/policy with no hard-resource interruption uses fixed attempt/order sequence; hard deadline interruption receipt recorded, not claimed timing deterministic
exp_method: enclose exp(-y) by reciprocals of positive Taylor sum and exact geometric upper remainder; absolute dyadic outward widening after initial reciprocal and EACH of s squarings; no fixed cutoff
exp_order: for each of 9 fixed rates and [x_lo,x_hi], reduce by least s>=0 with x_hi/2**s<=1/2; smallest n>=0 whose exact positive Taylor remainder enclosure has width <=2**(-P), subject to exp_order_max and bit/work/allocation caps
